name: change the default login shell of a user and persist it
definition: Set a user's default shell so a user-database lookup reports the new shell as default.
failure_mode: Shell is installed but never set as default, so the account lookup still reports the old shell.

name: combine values from reference clues to produce an expected payload
definition: perform a numerical/string transform defined among scattered artifacts to produce the value a service expects.
failure_mode: wrong arithmetic yields an incorrect payload to the service

name: compute and include derived statistics fields
definition: implement computed values (counts, aggregates) over the parsed records and include them in the designated portions of the output.
failure_mode: missing or waived aggregate fields fails the statistics calculation test

name: compute grouped/aggregated summaries over tabular and CSV inputs
definition: compute grouped/aggregated summaries over tabular and CSV inputs
failure_mode: missing the join, filtering the wrong period, or mis-summing revenue changes which products rank top into the ground-truth list
